answer: Reaching the nebula of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, forfeited on duplicate submission, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. A ripple of per-task receipts records who did what, and the voyage of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
